title: SMCH Operational Workflow State Machine Definitions
content:
WORKFLOW STATE MACHINE DEFINITIONS: Saveetha Medical College and Hospital (SMCH) Operational Workflow State Machine Definitions (workflow_definitions.json).
SPECIFIED WORKFLOWS:
- WF-001: Patient Emergency and Inpatient Admission (5 states: Demographic Check, Clinical Triage, Bed Allocation, Pre-Auth Check, Admission Finalization)
- WF-002: Four-Point Inpatient Discharge Clearance (4 states: Clinical Order, Pharmacy Audit, Billing Settlement, Nursing Gate Pass Release)
- WF-003: Cashless Insurance Pre-Authorization & Query Resolution (4 states: Card Verification, Estimate Packet, TPA Query Reply, Approval Confirmation)
- WF-004: Inpatient Ward and ICU Bed Transfer (4 states: Clinical Requisition, Vacancy Check, Buffer Override, SBAR Handover)
- WF-005: STAT Critical Lab Investigation & Panic Alert Escalation (4 states: STAT Order, Accessioning, Critical Trigger, Mandatory 15-Min Phone Readback)
- WF-006: Adverse Clinical & Operational Incident Reporting (4 states: Containment, Incident Logging, Quality Classification, CAPA Signoff)
- WF-007: Medico-Legal Case (MLC) Protocol & Intimation (4 states: Trauma Stabilization, Police Intimation Memo, Forensic Sealing, Legal Chart Lock)
- WF-008: High-Alert & Schedule X Narcotic Requisition (4 states: Consultant Indent, Bedside Dual-Witness, Vault Register Log, Ampoule Reconciliation)
All workflows enforce human-in-the-loop checkpoints, validation schemas, and automated escalation to support teams.
